<!DOCTYPE html><html  lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Cumulocity Partner Directory</title><script type="importmap">{"imports":{"#entry":"https://directory.static.partnerpage.io/_nuxt/MMuRm0LS.js"}}</script><script type="text/javascript" data-hid="custom-script-0">document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  console.log(1);

  // Smooth scroll to #end
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href="#end"]').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const target = document.getElementById("end");
      if (target) {
        window.scrollTo({
          top: target.offsetTop,
          behavior: "smooth"
        });
      }
    });
  });

  // Toggle nav-open class
  document.querySelectorAll('.navbar__btn--toggle').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      document.querySelector(".body")?.classList.toggle("nav-open");
    });

    btn.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      document.querySelector(".body")?.classList.toggle("nav-open");
    });
  });

  const hasChildrenBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.hasChildren > .nav-btn');
  const closeSubnavBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.close-subnav');
  const isWide = window.innerWidth > 991;

  if (isWide) {
    hasChildrenBtns.forEach(btn => {
      const parent = btn.parentElement;
      btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const allParents = document.querySelectorAll('.hasChildren');
        if (parent.classList.contains("sub-open")) {
          allParents.forEach(el => el.classList.remove("sub-open"));
        } else {
          allParents.forEach(el => el.classList.remove("sub-open"));
          parent.classList.add("sub-open");
        }
      });

      btn.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const allParents = document.querySelectorAll('.hasChildren');
        if (parent.classList.contains("sub-open")) {
          allParents.forEach(el => el.classList.remove("sub-open"));
        } else {
          allParents.forEach(el => el.classList.remove("sub-open"));
          parent.classList.add("sub-open");
        }
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (!event.target.closest('.hasChildren')) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.hasChildren').forEach(el => el.classList.remove("sub-open"));
      }
    });
  } else {
    hasChildrenBtns.forEach(btn => {
      const parent = btn.parentElement;
      btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        document.querySelector(".body")?.classList.add("nav-open--sub");
        parent.classList.toggle("sub-open");
      });

      btn.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        document.querySelector(".body")?.classList.add("nav-open--sub");
        parent.classList.toggle("sub-open");
      });
    });

    closeSubnavBtns.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        document.querySelector(".body")?.classList.remove("nav-open--sub");
        document.querySelectorAll('.hasChildren').forEach(el => el.classList.remove("sub-open"));
      });

      btn.addEventListener("touchstart", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        document.querySelector(".body")?.classList.remove("nav-open--sub");
        document.querySelectorAll('.hasChildren').forEach(el => el.classList.remove("sub-open"));
      });
    });
  }
